# Sawdagar Dokanpat

> A non-commercial, bilingual multi-vendor marketplace demonstration for Bangladesh, built as a portfolio project with Next.js 16, Prisma 7, Better Auth and Tailwind CSS 4.

Demo store: payments are sandbox only. No real money is accepted, and every product, seller, review and order is seeded demo data.

## What this is

Sawdagar Dokanpat gives independent Bangladeshi sellers one shared storefront. The seeded catalog has 12 departments, 84 categories, 24 vendors, 432 products and 1,296 variants, all written in English and Bangla.

Buyers can browse and search the catalog, choose a variant, keep a cart as a guest or signed-in user, save a wishlist, compare four products, apply a coupon, check out with a saved or new 64-district address, pay by cash on delivery or the MockPay sandbox, print an invoice, review a delivered product, ask a question and request a return within seven days.

Vendor owners get a Seller Center for store and KYC details, products, variants, stock adjustments, fulfillment, questions, returns, promotions, analytics, finance and a public store page. Platform staff get store approvals, review moderation, a Storefront/Help/Journal CMS with drafts, scheduling and version history, feature flags, platform analytics, finance decisions and an audit log.

The repository is a pnpm workspace orchestrated by Turborepo:

- apps/web: the Next.js App Router application, Prisma schema, migrations and seed scripts.
- packages/ui: design tokens, the brand mark and shared components with matching skeleton pairs.
- packages/domain: pure money, category, seed, role, coupon, order, finance and seller rules.
- packages/cs-core: a C++ search ranker and C SKU kit compiled to WebAssembly, with Python and Java reference modules and TypeScript ports.

## Architecture

- Next.js 16 App Router with React 19. Pages are Server Components; client components hold only interaction state such as the cart drawer and variant picker.
- Mutations are Server Actions that validate input with Zod, resolve the viewer from the session and re-read prices and stock on the server. No price, role, user id or total is accepted from the browser.
- Prisma 7 with the pg driver adapter on Neon PostgreSQL. Migrations and seeds run only through the Database GitHub Actions workflow, never from a developer machine.
- Better Auth provides email/password sessions and rate limits. Role areas are enforced by server guards, and the eight demo accounts are allowlisted.
- Tailwind CSS 4 tokens in packages/ui/src/theme.css drive both themes. The theme and locale are read from cookies before the first paint, so there is no flash or client-side patch.
- Catalog search is ordered by a C++ relevance ranker compiled to WebAssembly, with an integer-only TypeScript port as the fallback. SKU check characters come from a C module; demand signals and payout settlement have Python and Java reference implementations.
- CI runs lint, typecheck, 170 unit tests and a production build on Linux, Windows and macOS, plus a reference-module job. A manual and weekly Lighthouse workflow audits the deployment with three mobile runs per URL.
- Deployed on Vercel Hobby, with the database on Neon Free. Full detail: https://github.com/ibrahimSumon47/sawdagar-dokanpart/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md

## Demo accounts

Open https://sawdagar-dokanpart.vercel.app/sign-in and use a Try demo button. No password is shown or needed. The allowlist is:

- Buyer: buyer@demo.sawdagar.test
- Vendor owner: vendor@demo.sawdagar.test
- Vendor staff: staff@demo.sawdagar.test
- Support agent: support@demo.sawdagar.test
- Moderator: moderator@demo.sawdagar.test
- Finance admin: finance@demo.sawdagar.test
- Content editor: editor@demo.sawdagar.test
- Super admin: admin@demo.sawdagar.test

Demo accounts cannot change their email or password. Signing in as the super admin opens the full admin area by design, because the data is non-sensitive demo content.

## Constraints

- The demo is non-commercial, required by Vercel Hobby. There are no ads, affiliate links or real transactions.
- Payments are cash on delivery and the MockPay sandbox only. SSLCommerz sandbox and Stripe test mode need owner accounts and are not wired; refunds are ledger entries, not gateway refunds.
- Each department has one licensed representative photograph shared by its products, not a photograph of each item. Review photos are bounded data URLs in PostgreSQL because no object storage is configured.
- The Python and Java modules are reference implementations checked in CI; requests use the TypeScript ports.
- Search matches English and Bangla titles and leaf-category names, ranks at most 120 matches, and has no stemming, transliteration or autocomplete.
- Seeded reviews belong to synthetic buyers without login accounts. Cart totals in the drawer are estimates; checkout charges shipping per seller and destination zone.
- Known limitations: https://github.com/ibrahimSumon47/sawdagar-dokanpart/blob/main/README.md#known-limitations
